column1: # Golden queries: what a learner expects the search to return (search-quality benchmark).
# Run (needs the real packs unpacked: core.sqlite, stdict.sqlite, e.g. pipeline/out after a pipeline build):
# Packs default to core,stdict (the app's default); KDICT_GOLDEN_PACKS=core,stdict,opendict to change.
# scripts/verify.sh runs it when pipeline/out/core.sqlite (or $KDICT_PACKS/core.sqlite) exists.
# Prints pass / FAIL / known / FIXED per line and a score; fails only when a line not marked
# "known" fails (a regression). A "known" line that passes is reported as FIXED: drop the mark.
# Columns (tab-separated): query, check, expected, status, note
#   check     first      the first distinct headword is one of `expected`
#             topN       one of `expected` is among the first N distinct headwords
#             hanjaN     a row among the first N rows is headword=HANJA (e.g. 선물=膳物)
#             nothanjaN  no row among the first N rows is headword=HANJA (a wrong hanja)
#   expected  alternatives separated by |; headwords compare without spaces/hyphens (선물 가게 = 선물가게)
#   status    ok, or known (a known failure of the current engine: reported, never fails the run)
# == Korean headwords: the word itself comes first
# == homonyms: the word first, and its common meanings among the results with the right hanja
# == conjugated forms: the dictionary form comes first
